# Delta Et Directory

**Author:** M. El Aabaribaoune

## Purpose
Contains Block 2 Transfer targets.

## Canonical Targets
- `delta_rzsm`
- `delta_et` (DA-minus-OPL ET response)
- `delta_surface_runoff`
- `delta_baseflow`

## Definition
Defined strictly as `DA - OPL`.

## Interpretation
These are model-response targets evaluating the downstream impact of assimilation. They are NOT observational error metrics.
**Important:** Files in this directory are generated by project scripts. Do NOT manually modify generated NetCDF products. Regenerate through the corresponding preprocessing script.
